dedupe_keys.name: dublin fire brigade fire and ambulance incident activity logs 2011 to 2025

description: This dataset holds the annual incident activity logs of Dublin Fire Brigade, which runs both the fire service and an emergency ambulance service for the Dublin region. Dublin City Council publishes the logs on Ireland's national open data portal and on Smart Dublin. Each incident row gives the date, station area and district, the incident type or ambulance priority category (from Echo, life-threatening cardiac or respiratory arrest, through Delta, Charlie, Bravo and Alpha to Omega, minor illness or injury), and the times generated by the vehicle status system: call received in the control centre, first vehicle ordered, mobile, arrived on scene, left scene, arrived at hospital, available again and incident closed. Separate fire and ambulance files cover 2011 to 2025, released as yearly or multi-year CSV files with GeoJSON versions, free under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: file layouts change between years, locations are given as areas, not addresses, and status times depend on crews pressing buttons, so some are missing or out of order. Simulation uses: calibrating ambulance and fire response-time models, estimating hospital turnaround and handover delays, and testing station and fleet plans for a European capital. Related records: the London Fire Brigade incident records (data-london-fire-brigade-incident-records) and the FDNY EMS dispatch data (data-nyc-fdny-ems-incident-dispatch) are comparable city feeds.
